A new check makes existing code fail. Requiring the corpus to certify at unchanged levels pressures every new obligation toward being weak enough that nothing breaks, which is plausibly how the effect row came to be unchecked in both directions in the first place. The honest resolution is to break the corpus and fix it, and that costs exactly the migration work the other telos is trying to keep small.
